Q7 PASS -- the first component explains 29.3%, so the annotation blocks are not one latent thing
Q8 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
Biotype is assigned by NAME PATTERN, not by GENCODE. The rule will miss unnamed
ENSG entries entirely -- and unnamed entries are 4 of the top 10 loadings -- so Q2
UNDERSTATES the enrichment and Q4 removes less than the full class.
Naming a component's carriers is not proving a mechanism. Library preparation is
the best explanation for these biotypes moving together, but a genuine biological
difference in snoRNA processing between two cultures would look identical from
here, and ENCODE publishes no per-replicate batch metadata for this series.
If Q4 fails, the honest reading is that the biotypes MARK the artefact rather than
constitute it, and the component is broader than the classes that flag it.
